title: Double Counting repeats a Death a Unit was given, and Windfast's stand-in keeps to the attack rules
notes: R823, R1107: the state check's collect step reruns a granted Death under a Cry and Death multiplier, as it reruns a printed one (grants::death_hook_of). R1202, R1849005: Windfast's substitute is held to §4.2 step 2 in a forced attack too, before a Prime substitute's joiners; a barred substitute, forced or declared, makes no attack and the base face bounces it. A replay through either path folds to another state and is refused as rules_changed (R767000).

player.title: Double Counting and given Deaths, Windfast's stand-in
fixes: Double Counting now repeats a Death a Unit was given, like the one Permanent Underclassman and Permanent Upperclassman give the Unit they summon.
When Windfast is forced to attack, the Unit that attacks for it now follows the attack rules: if it may not attack that target (The Gauntlet, a lane-only Unit, Flying), it makes no attack.
On Windfast's base face, a Unit that could not make Windfast's attack still goes back to its owner's hand.
